K3.Weierstrass_equation: the polynomial Weierstrass family A_K3,B_K3 in the pinned baseline
K3.base_change: u=N(t)/D(t), with N,D and ninth cubic section L(t) from pinned input
K3.sections: Pull back the eight source basis points and cubic_to_Weierstrass(L(t)) along u=N(t)/D(t), then multiply x by D(t)^2 and y by D(t)^3
K3.specialization_to_source_fibre: Divide x,y by D(1)^2,D(1)^3, then apply the stored source fibre isomorphism and short-to-public map

cubic_to_Weierstrass.rule: Set (v,w,z)=M_inverse(u)*(X,Y,Z); x=-a*b*v/z; y=a*b^2*v*w/z^2. Then apply stored (k,r,s,q): x_c=(x-r)/k^2, y_c=(y-s*(x-r)-q)/k^3. Extend across removable points; P1 maps to O.

proof_boundary: This completes a generic MW8 basis for an imposed rational pencil and saturates the known K3 rank-nine span. It neither proves full K3 rank nine nor recovers hidden provenance or a high-rank parent. No new rational curve rank or parameter search.

remaining_rank_gate.known_anti_invariant: 2*S-h, where h=Q+C1 and S is the moving ninth section

saturation_certificate.proof: det=2^9, so any proper even integral overlattice has an order-two first step. Every admissible coset contains a vector of height 2. All fibres are I1, so a nonzero K3 section has height 4+2(P.O)>=4. No such step exists.
